#!/usr/bin/env python3
import feedparser, textwrap, os, datetime, json

# ------------------- Configuration -------------------
RSS_URL = "https://hnrss.org/frontpage"          # 示例 RSS 源
MAX_ITEMS = 3                                     # 取前几条
MAX_SENTENCES = 3                                 # 摘要句数
OUTPUT_DIR = "data/output"
# -----------------------------------------------------

def fetch_entries(url, limit=MAX_ITEMS):
    """获取 RSS 条目，返回前 limit 条"""
    feed = feedparser.parse(url)
    return feed.entries[:limit]

def summarize(text, max_sentences=MAX_SENTENCES):
    """极简摘要：取前 max_sentences 句（以句号分割）"""
    sentences = text.split('. ')
    summary = '. '.join(sentences[:max_sentences])
    # 用 textwrap 美化换行
    return '\n'.join(textwrap.wrap(summary, width=120))

def build_output_path():
    """生成今日的输出文件路径"""
    today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%Y%m%d")
    filename = f"digest_{today}.txt"
    return os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename)

def main():
    os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    entries = fetch_entries(RSS_URL)

    lines = []
    for i, entry in enumerate(entries, 1):
        title = entry.get("title", "No Title")
        link = entry.get("link", "")
        summary_raw = entry.get("summary", "")
        summary = summarize(summary_raw)

        lines.append(f"{i}. {title}")
        lines.append(f"Link: {link}")
        lines.append("Summary:")
        lines.append(summary)
        lines.append("-" * 40)

    output_path = build_output_path()
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(lines))

    print(f"Digest written to: {output_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
